answer_1.quote: We first train a transformer-based literal listener as a model that takes in the three colors and a natural language utterance, and uses these to predict the index of the referent. We also train a transformer-based speaker model, which takes in the context and target referent and generates a natural language utterance.
datasets: Frank (2016) reference games (SIMPLE, COMPLEX, TWINS, ODDMAN)
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language utterances used to refer to target colors or meanings in reference games

answer_2.quote: We compute the correlation between p(meaning | utterance) predicted by the model, and the average p(meaning | utterance) predicted by humans... Top-1 accuracy of predicting meanings on the validation set of the Colors in Context task.

answer_4.quote: Frank gathered graded human judgments about the probability that particular utterances might carry particular meanings.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the probability that each utterance conveys each possible meaning.
